Definition: Sebam or Sibmah, a place in Moab
BiblicalUsage: Shebam or Shibmah or Sibmah = "fragrance"; 1) one of the towns in the pastoral district on the east of the Jordan in Moab; allotted to the tribes of Reuben and Gad
